mechanism: 靜脈輸注之單株抗體，設計上選擇性結合病理性 α-synuclein 的原纖維／聚集體形式，目標為降低其細胞間擴散
phase: Ph2a（隨機、安慰劑對照、四重盲、多重劑量遞增；2:1 分派）
status: 已完成（完成日 2026-08-10，登錄於 2026-08-21 更新為 Completed）。此即 BioArctic 的 EXIST 研究，同時納入輕中度帕金森病與 MSA 兩個族群，實際收案 38 人（原設計約 36 人，其中 MSA 約 12 人），起始 2024-10-24，站點 7 站、位於波蘭 2 站與西班牙 5 站。主要指標為不良事件與嚴重不良事件人數（安全性與耐受性），非療效。公司先前於 2025-06 公布期中安全性審查結果為安全、耐受良好並據以啟動第二劑量世代。⚠️ 截至目前尚無任何療效或生物標記結果公開讀出；公司公開表示正在籌備 Ph2b，但未見公開的啟動時程。

en.mechanism: An intravenously infused monoclonal antibody designed to bind selectively to fibrillar/aggregated forms of pathological alpha-synuclein, with the aim of reducing cell-to-cell spread
en.phase: Ph2a (randomised, placebo-controlled, quadruple-blind, multiple ascending dose; 2:1 allocation)
en.status: Completed (completion date 2026-08-10; the registration was updated to Completed on 2026-08-21). This is BioArctic's EXIST study, which enrolled both mild-to-moderate Parkinson's disease and MSA cohorts, with an actual enrolment of 38 (against an original design of roughly 36, of whom about 12 had MSA), started 2024-10-24, across 7 sites — 2 in Poland and 5 in Spain. The primary outcome is the number of participants with adverse events and serious adverse events (safety and tolerability), not efficacy. The company reported in June 2025 that an interim safety review found the drug safe and well tolerated, on the basis of which the second dose cohorts were opened. ⚠️ No efficacy or biomarker results have been read out publicly to date; the company has said publicly that it is preparing a Phase 2b, but no start timing has been disclosed.

mechanism: D-胺基酸氧化酶（DAAO）抑制劑（口服，一日兩次）；公司自述機轉為抑制發炎細胞激素、降低神經發炎並促進神經可塑性
phase: Ph2（雙盲、安慰劑對照、多中心、劑量遞增）
status: 收案完成、雙盲進行中（登錄狀態查核日 2026-08，最後更新 2026-08-19；收 30 歲以上、依 MDS 準則確診之 MSA 病人，MSA-P 與 MSA-C 皆收；主要終點為不良事件發生率與嚴重度，次要終點為藥物動力學、UMSARS 與 10 公尺步行測試；站點：美國 6 站、日本 1 站、台灣 2 站；收案數兩來源不一致——公司 2026-07-28 新聞稿稱完成 90 人，CT.gov 登錄預計 75 人，兩者並列；公司表示 topline 預計 2027 Q1 公布）
sponsor: 思捷優達 Dasher Neuroscience（台灣）

en.mechanism: D-amino acid oxidase (DAAO) inhibitor (oral, twice daily); the company describes the mechanism as inhibiting inflammatory cytokines, reducing neuroinflammation and enhancing neuroplasticity
en.status: Enrolment complete, double-blind phase ongoing (registry status verified 2026-08, last updated 2026-08-19; enrolling MSA patients aged 30 and over diagnosed per MDS criteria, both MSA-P and MSA-C; primary endpoint the incidence and severity of adverse events, secondary endpoints pharmacokinetics, UMSARS and the 10-Metre Walk Test; sites in the United States (6), Japan (1) and Taiwan (2); the two sources disagree on enrolment — the company's 2026-07-28 press release states 90 completed, the CT.gov registration lists a target of 75, and both are reported here; the company expects topline data in Q1 2027)

mechanism: 人源化單株抗體，設計上選擇性結合病理性 α-synuclein 聚集體，可能減少其擴散與相關神經發炎（登錄未載明開發廠商）
